page.overview:
Who is Cuticle Toru?

Cuticle Toru (キューティクル透 Kyūtikuru Tōru?) is the second character created in the Street Fighter Laboratory corner. Toru is an idol with a very effeminate appearance, whose catchphrase is yelling out "Japaaan!" (「ジャパァン！」?)

Mika's Comment: She's 28 years old, older than me.... Apparently she started working out because she got dumped. ...Sad. But tears are muscles for tomorrow! She uses the muscles she trained in ballet to deliver some nasty kicks! Oh, and she also throws roses. Category:Concept Characters Category:Characters
